frameEvidence.visualInspection: Recognizable lit Humus brick-room scene rendered from the original executable.

limitations: This validates the new render-target operations with actual WebGPU hardware and checks one original Humus program for regressions; broad game compatibility remains in progress.

The Humus executable did not exercise the new offscreen render-target API in this run; the browser diagnostic performs the target creation, binding, clear, draw, sampling, readback, lifetime, and error checks.

Supported color formats are A8R8G8B8 and X8R8G8B8; supported depth format is D24S8; multisampling, lockable render targets, readback/copy APIs, MRT slots above zero, other depth formats, and volume textures remain unsupported.
Present submission intervals do not equal display scan-out or GPU shader duration.
